pattern: て済むことではない（てすむことではない）
purpose: Say that an easy response cannot settle a serious matter.
keywords: Vて + 済むことではない
This is not something an apology can settle.
Simply replacing what was broken will not put this right.
Changing the person in charge will not resolve this.
formation: Vて + 済むことではない
restrictions: Often criticizes an apology or replacement as inadequate.
mistake: The preceding action is the insufficient remedy.
